{{SW|url=news/tales-from-the-death-star-interview|text=Cavan Scott on the Ghoulactic Horrors of ''Tales from the Death Star''}} states that the events of ''[[Star Wars Adventures: Tales from Vader's Castle]]'' take place around the time of the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'',  which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[1 BBY]]. ''Timelines'' also dates the flashback events of [[Star Wars Adventures: Tales from Vader's Castle 4|''Star Wars Adventures: Tales from Vader's Castle'' 4]] to 1 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], therefore meaning ''Tales from Vader's Castle'' must occur in 1 BBY.<noinclude>[[Category:Canon dating citation templates]]
